query: INSERT INTO central.recovery_coordinators (recovery_domain, instance_id, lease_token_hash, fencing_generation, lease_expires_at, state, created_at, updated_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, 1, clock_timestamp() + interval '30 seconds', 'claimed', clock_timestamp(), clock_timestamp()) ON CONFLICT (recovery_domain) DO UPDATE SET instance_id = EXCLUDED.instance_id, lease_token_hash = EXCLUDED.lease_token_hash, fencing_generation = CASE WHEN central.recovery_coordinators.lease_expires_at <= clock_timestamp() OR central.recovery_coordinators.instance_id <> EXCLUDED.instance_id THEN central.recovery_coordinators.fencing_generation + 1 ELSE central.recovery_coordinators.fencing_generation END, lease_expires_at = clock_timestamp() + interval '30 seconds', state = 'claimed', updated_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE central.recovery_coordinators.lease_expires_at <= clock_timestamp() OR central.recovery_coordinators.instance_id = EXCLUDED.instance_id RETURNING fencing_generation, lease_expires_at
